response.rationale: High anion gap metabolic acidosis with normal lactate, ketones, and salicylate in a patient on acetaminophen strongly suggests pyroglutamic acidemia; urine organic acid analysis is confirmatory.

rejected.why: Lactic acidosis is excluded by normal lactate (0.7 mmol/L).
Salicylate toxicity excluded by low salicylate level (<0.4 mmol/L).
DKA excluded by normal blood ketones (<0.2 mmol/L).
Renal tubular acidosis unlikely given unchanged renal function and high anion gap.
